field_rules.asset_id: stable immutable id; never derive selection from company identity
field_rules.source_url: must point to provider asset/detail page or company-provided provenance record, not only a CDN binary
field_rules.license_terms_checked_at: ISO-8601 date required for provider-license assets
field_rules.binary_sha256: required once the exact binary enters Production cache; protects against silent provider replacement
field_rules.evidence_status: generic stock/generated material can never be promoted to ACTUAL_COMPANY_EVIDENCE by crop, copy, placement, or visual similarity
field_rules.prohibited_uses: must explicitly include any misleading person/store/result/endorsement use that is unsafe for the asset
field_rules.recheck_policy: must encode triggers, not only a date; provider-term changes, source disappearance, rights dispute, binary change, or expiry must invalidate cached approval

generic_stock_hard_boundary: must not be captioned as actual staff
must not be captioned as actual customer/client
must not be captioned as actual store/studio/salon
must not be captioned as actual treatment/training result
must not imply endorsement by depicted person/brand
must not support factual performance/efficacy/qualification claims
